interpretation.mean_distortion: Monte Carlo estimate of expected finite-realization projection distortion conditional on feasibility.
interpretation.gaussian_loss_prior: Layer-2-aligned prior mismatch, 0.5 * sum standardized target errors squared.
interpretation.projected_gaussian_loss: Residual scenario mismatch after projection, measured in the same sigma-normalized units.
interpretation.uncertainty_tau: For projection_mode='uncertainty_set', global_scalar/attribute_normalized require projected_gaussian_loss <= uncertainty_tau; attribute_constraints uses per-attribute tau values.
interpretation.uncertainty_aggregation: global_scalar: raw target-level sum; attribute_normalized: category-count-normalized attribute losses with optional weights; attribute_constraints: per-attribute uncertainty set constraints.
interpretation.projection_objective: For hard/uncertainty_set this equals KL distortion; for soft it equals KL + soft_lambda * sum standardized errors squared.
interpretation.agent_nESS: TRUE per-AGENT normalized effective sample size: 1/(N * sum_c w_c^2/n_c). Accounts for cell sizes when input is cell-aggregated. Deployment-relevant: 'how many distinct agents effectively contribute'. See §12 of LAYER-3 doc.
interpretation.cell_nESS: Per-ROW (=per-CELL in cell-aggregated mode) normalized ESS: 1/(K * sum_c w_c^2). Measures joint-pattern diversity of the posterior. Equals agent_nESS only when all cells have equal size.
interpretation.max_agent_weight: Maximum per-agent weight (= max_k w_k / n_k). Deployment-relevant concentration metric.
interpretation.distortion_lower_bound: Mode-specific theorem diagnostic: hard bound or uncertainty-set bound on KL distortion.
interpretation.objective_lower_bound: For soft mode, theorem diagnostic for the penalized objective lower bound.
interpretation.simulation-ready: projection is feasible and not strongly degenerate under the configured thresholds
interpretation.use-with-caution: projection is feasible but shows notable distortion or weight concentration
interpretation.not-supported: scenario is not stably supported by the generated prior realizations
